frameConvention: Half-open [startFrame,endFrame). Scene boundaries rounded cumulatively; final boundary ceiled to contain all audio. Seconds equal frames / fps.
scriptPolicy: Script preserved verbatim as reference; recorded narration wins. ASR must not be used as captions or as a replacement script. Potential differences documented in plan.

audio.placement: Concatenate decoded audio1.ogg through audio8.ogg at their exact sample boundaries into a continuous 48000 Hz mono PCM track at time zero. Do not independently round each clip to a frame, trim silence, time-stretch, or reorder.

captions: Short Arabic phrases only, per workspace preference; no full narration captions.

sync.leadMeaning: Events are planned near 0.3 s before their illustrative word when speech provides setup; exact anchors require ear review. Do not subtract lead again.
sync.cuts: Use measured clip-boundary silence; no inserted pause or audio edit.

scenes.voiceover: علاش تثبت بلي راك إنسان؟ تدخل لموقع، حاب تفتح حساب برك، يخرجلك: اختار كامل الصور اللي فيهم feu rouge. تقول: واش دخلني أنا فالطريق؟

props.representation: A browser action is interrupted by the recurring checkpoint. The image grid makes the familiar annoyance understandable with the sound muted.

events.action: Browser form and blue request move immediately; closed checkpoint and question mark are visible.
Checkpoint unfolds into a progressively revealed 3×3 vector traffic-light grid; do not show the grid before the request is interrupted.
Cursor pauses; question mark above the extra checkpoint enlarges. Use the recording's question, without adding the missing spoken hook or joke.
Grid compresses into the same checkpoint silhouette; hold the unanswered question into the queue scene.

scenes.voiceover: باش تفهم علاش، تخيّل واحد قدّامك فالطابور، كل مرة يرجع بلبسة جديدة ويشد بلاصة. فالإنترنت، برنامج واحد يقدر يعاود نفس العملية آلياً، ويزاحم الناس اللي راهم يستعملو الموقع عادي.

props.representation: One repeated queue member becomes repeated request cards; one source producing many operations explains the unfair scale.

events.action: Checkpoint stays in place as the site doorway; queue grows one figure at a time, maximum three initially.
One violet figure changes its hat and rejoins; repeat twice, leaving other people waiting.
Queue transforms into browser request cards; a small label marks the move from analogy to website, with no added narration.
One violet source duplicates numbered cards 01, 02, 03; these IDs are illustrative, not a measured rate.
Blue request waits behind the violet batch; question mark moves to the checkpoint.

scenes.voiceover: هذا يسمّوه bot: برنامج يخدم وحدو. وكاين اللي يستعملوه باش يفتح حسابات مزوّرة، يعمّر التعليقات بالإشهار، ولا يجرّب كلمات السر المسروقة. وهنا، الموقع يحتاج طريقة باش ينقص هاذ الاستغلال.

props.representation: A neutral automation source produces cards; only the harmful examples receive a warning marker. Recorded examples provisionally follow account creation, stolen-password attempts, and bulk data collection.

events.action: Snap the label bot onto the existing violet source, with a three-word Arabic definition; no new mascot.
Show neutral tasks briefly with no warning, so automation itself is not branded malicious.
First example: source emits duplicate profile cards behind the checkpoint.
Replace the cards with a lock and several invalid key attempts; no password-cracking code.

events.anchor: يجمع كمية كبيرة من المعلومات (ASR candidate)
events.action: Replace the lock with document cards being pulled from a website into one batch, marked excessive collection, not all collection.
Collapse examples into the incoming batch and highlight the site's need for a checkpoint.
Briefly dim the source, leaving the checkpoint ready to open in scene 4.

scenes.voiceover: من هنا جات فكرة CAPTCHA: اختبار يحاول يفرّق بين الإنسان والبرنامج. الفكرة الأصلية كانت تعطيك حاجة الإنسان يفهمها، بصح تصعاب على البرامج، كيما حروف معوّجة تقراها وتعاود تكتبها فالخانة اللي تحتها.

props.representation: Open the same checkpoint and show one historical challenge example. Input and outcome are causally connected, without implying a perfect identity proof.

events.action: Bring checkpoint forward; prior request batch remains dim in the background.
Reveal CAPTCHA label; add two simple source silhouettes in succession, then dim them.
Small historical-example marker appears; show the challenge panel with empty content first.
Reveal distorted Latin sample K7M2 with a readable input below; keep sample isolated LTR.
Type K7M2 into the input one character at a time; local demonstration only.
Checkpoint opens for the example request; retain the question mark outline rather than certifying a person.

scenes.voiceover: بصح علاش اليوم نشوفو صور وحوايج أخرى؟ خاطر البرامج تطوّرت، والاختبارات هاذي ماشي ضمان كامل. الحماية لازم تتبدّل هي ثاني. وحتى كي تغلط فصورة، هذا ما يعنيش بلي راك robot!

props.representation: A changing checkpoint and a retry show that tests evolve and a person's error is not proof of automation.

events.action: Historical text panel morphs into the familiar image grid, one row at a time.
Violet source gains a small capability arrow; checkpoint outline remains visibly incomplete.
Checkpoint swaps its challenge module, keeping its position and request route unchanged.
Cursor chooses one wrong tile; neutral retry icon, no malicious-bot label on the human.
Retry panel settles, preparing to disappear in the next scene.

scenes.voiceover: وزيد، ماشي كل تحقق يحتاج صور. كاين أنظمة كيما reCAPTCHA v3 تخدم فالخلفية: تحلّل التفاعل تاعك مع الموقع وتعطيه تقدير للخطر، باش يختار كيفاش يتعامل مع الطلب اللي راهو جايه.

props.representation: X-ray the same checkpoint: interaction context feeds a qualitative risk estimate, and the website chooses a response. This distinguishes assessment from certainty.

events.action: Visible challenge drawer closes; browser remains usable and request route stays visible.
Attach reCAPTCHA v3 label to the background module, isolated LTR; no CAPTCHA image challenge inside v3.
Reveal one interaction card at a time flowing toward an assessment panel; do not invent exact telemetry or mouse rules.
Qualitative risk indicator appears with uncertainty label; no invented score or threshold.
Only now reveal a separate site decision: proceed or request an additional check; make clear the website selects the action.

scenes.voiceover: يعني الهدف هو يصعّب الاستغلال الآلي: يخلي فتح الحسابات ولا إرسال التعليقات بالجملة أصعب على اللي يستعمل برامج للإزعاج. يقدر يعطّلهم، بصح ما يضمنش بلي كل واحد يفوت راهو إنسان مية بالمية.

props.representation: The batch slows at the checkpoint; one uncertain request slips through. Summarize reduced automated abuse rather than guaranteed humanity.

events.action: Show the complete route using already introduced objects; emphasize the checkpoint's purpose.
Account cards and bulk document cards approach; match the recorded examples provisionally, not the script's comments example.
Batch visibly queues while a blue request continues; do not show an invented success rate.
One violet card passes; keep its source marker so passing does not recolor it as human.
Settle into a clean save frame: batch → checkpoint → site, with a small uncertainty marker and the six-word takeaway. Hold through scene end.

scenes.voiceover: هاذيك الثواني اللي تغيّضك كي تختار الصور، راها جزء من محاولة حماية الموقع. وهاك علاش، باش تدخل لعالم رقمي... يطلبو منك تثبت بلي راك إنسان.

props.representation: Return from the system view to the familiar browser interruption: the inconvenience now has a purpose. End on the opening browser geometry for a loop.

events.action: Grid and checkpoint sit inside a partial shield; no impenetrable shield or identity-certified stamp.
Zoom back to the exact browser layout from frame 1; question mark becomes a short purpose tag, then fades.
Show the sole CTA: حروف ولا صور؟ in the lower-middle phrase area for 2 s. Do not add a spoken line.
Emphasize the existing verification ring once, then return cursor and grid to their opening positions.
Fade the question and return the phrase area to the opening question for the final composition.
Finish matching the opening composition; retain all recorded trailing silence and the final partial-frame hold.
